He built facilities (warehouse, drying) on the land without proper land use permits, i.e., illegally occupied cultivated land (耕地). The authorities issued stop orders, but he continued. He occupied 14.79 mu of cultivated land.

What is the charge? In examples, similar case: "非法占用农用地" was used for a case where someone occupied farmland for other uses. So the charge is "非法占用农用地". Also there is "非法占用耕地" maybe same. The label used in examples: "非法占用农用地". So we should output that.

Check if any other charge like "非法占用耕地" appears? Not in examples. So use "非法占用农用地". No other charges.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法占用农用地<eoa>
